moving-box.definition: A sturdy box used to pack belongings for transport when moving homes.
moving-box.exampleUsage: Books were packed in a small moving box.

packing-tape.definition: Strong adhesive tape used to seal cartons and packages.
packing-tape.exampleUsage: Packing tape sealed the moving box.

bubble-wrap.definition: To surround an object with bubble wrap, protecting it from damage while it is stored or shipped.

packing-paper.definition: Paper used to wrap and cushion items inside boxes during packing.
packing-paper.exampleUsage: Glassware was wrapped in packing paper.

marker.definition: Some conspicuous object used to distinguish or mark something.

moving-blanket.definition: A thick padded blanket used to protect furniture and large objects during transport.
moving-blanket.exampleUsage: A moving blanket covered the table during transport.

dolly.definition: A wheeled platform used to move a camera smoothly.

hand-truck.definition: A small cart with two wheels, upper handles, and a bottom platform helps move crates and other heavy loads.

rope.definition: A strong cord used for tying or securing things.

zip-tie.definition: A narrow plastic fastening strip that locks into a loop when tightened.
zip-tie.exampleUsage: Zip ties kept loose cables grouped during the move.

pack.definition: A sheet or blanket (either dry or wet) to wrap around the body for its therapeutic effect.

load.definition: To put goods or belongings into a vehicle or container.

unload.definition: To remove the load from (a container or vehicle).

unpack.definition: To take belongings out of boxes or bags after moving.

label.definition: A brief description given for purposes of identification.

donate.definition: To give to a charity or good cause.

discard.definition: Anything that is cast aside or discarded.

disassemble.definition: To take apart into its constituent pieces.

reassemble.definition: To assemble once again, after taking something apart.

change-address.definition: To update official records and contacts with a new home or mailing address.
change-address.exampleUsage: The family changed its address with important services after moving.

transfer-utilities.definition: To arrange for services such as electricity, water, or gas to move from one account or address to another.
transfer-utilities.exampleUsage: The adults contacted providers to transfer utilities to the new home.

install-internet.definition: To set up an internet connection and necessary network equipment at a home or workplace.
install-internet.exampleUsage: A qualified technician came to install internet service.

register-vehicle.definition: To record a vehicle with the relevant government authority as required by local law.
register-vehicle.exampleUsage: The owner checked local rules to register the vehicle after moving.

update-license.definition: To change official information on a license, such as an address, through the responsible authority.
update-license.exampleUsage: The adult driver followed local procedures to update the license.

find-doctor.definition: To identify a suitable healthcare professional or clinic for future care.
find-doctor.exampleUsage: The family used its healthcare network to find a doctor nearby.

enroll-in-school.definition: To complete the official process of joining a school or educational program as a student.

meet-neighbors.definition: To introduce yourself to people who live nearby and begin getting to know them.
meet-neighbors.exampleUsage: The family met the neighbors after moving in.

explore-area.definition: To visit and learn about the streets, services, parks, and other features of a new local area.
explore-area.exampleUsage: They explored the area to find the library and grocery store.

housewarming.definition: A party of people assembled to celebrate moving into a new home.

sofa.definition: A comfortable seat with a back and space for several people.

dining-table.definition: A table where people sit to eat meals together.

bookcase.definition: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

coffee-table.definition: A low table near a sofa for holding drinks and books.

tv-stand.definition: A stand or cabinet that supports a television.
